name: PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk
summary: Established in 2015 and headquartered in Tangerang Selatan, Indonesia, PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk, along with its subsidiaries, delivers a comprehensive suite of digital solutions to clients worldwide. The company's business activities are structured across four main divisions: Programming Services, Software Project Development Services, IT Consulting Services, and Subscription Services. Its offerings include the development of custom software products and mobile applications, provision of expert consulting, and various other services. Additionally, PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk provides Internet of Things (IoT) devices for applications like smart offices and retail, operates WhizLiz – a marketplace for luxury items – and conducts coding and programming education for graduates from high schools and vocational institutions. Its diverse client base spans startups, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), large corporations, and government organizations.
